description: This file defines the ResidentFormScreen widget for managing resident data entry in a Flutter app. It includes form fields for resident attributes like name, unit, phone, email, and notes, and supports both creating and editing residents via navigation arguments. The widget interacts with a ResidentProvider for data operations.

classes.name: ResidentFormArgs
classes.description: Holds arguments for navigation to ResidentFormScreen, including the mode (create/edit) and optionally a Resident object.

classes.name: ResidentFormScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides a form for creating or editing a Resident.

classes.name: _ResidentFormScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the form state, validation, and submission logic for ResidentFormScreen.

methods.name: _ResidentFormScreenState.build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the resident form screen, initializing form fields depending on whether it's in create or edit mode.

methods.name: _ResidentFormScreenState._handleSubmit
methods.description: Validates form input, updates or creates a Resident via provider, and navigates back upon success.
